title: Gary Connery's Wingsuit Landing without using a Parachute
summary: Stuntman Gary Connery jumps from a helicopter at 2,400 feet in a wingsuit and lands without a parachute on a runway of stacked cardboard boxes, the first such landing.
why: Cited as an example of how padding can allow survival of very high-speed impacts.

quote.text: jumped from a helicopter at 2,400 feet (730 metres) and steered himself using a wingsuit onto a runway of vertically stacked cardboard boxes.
